ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED Lenses section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.
A lens is deterministic — same inputs, same graph state, same answer, replayable [M5]. If it needs a model it is not a lens (that is MATCHING — inward flow).
Every lens declares: name+version · reads (closed) · yields (declared shape) · completeness · writes NOTHING ever.
The union of all reads columns, held against all layer 2-3 node classes, IS the reachability accounting: every class read by some lens or carrying a recorded exclusion. Built as CHECK-LENS-D1.
